name: FLA_ASSETS_INT
description: FLA_ASSETS_INT contains the lease assets information like asset number, inventory item associated to asset, asset location and employee tagged for asset etc.

columns.name: INTERFACE_ASSET_ID
columns.description: Interface Asset identifier. This column consistutes primary key along with LOAD_REQUEST_ID column of the table.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Oracle Enterprise Scheduler: request identifier of the interface load job that created the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: INTERFACE_LEASE_ID
columns.description: Interface Lease identifier. It references the primary key of the FLA_LEASES_INT table.

columns.name: ASSET_NUMBER
columns.description: Asset number which is either automatically generated or entered by the user, based on the system setup option.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Date from which the asset is active.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Date from which the asset is inactive.

columns.name: EMPLOYEE_ID
columns.description: Employee with whom the asset is tagged with.

columns.name: EMPLOYEE_EMAIL_ADDRESS
columns.description: E-mail address of the employee to whom the asset is assigned.

columns.name: INSTALL_SITE_ID
columns.description: Site information at which the asset is being installed

columns.name: INSTALL_SITE_CODE
columns.description: Physical location of the inventory item.

columns.name: INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
columns.description: Inventory item identifier. It is associated with the item being chosen as asset from the inventory system.

columns.name: INVENTORY_ITEM_NUMBER
columns.description: Inventory item number. It is associated with the item being chosen as asset from the inventory system.

columns.name: ITEM_CATEGORY_CODE
columns.description: Item category to pick the items belonging to the specific group.

columns.name: ASSET_MODEL_CODE
columns.description: Model of the asset that describes the asset.

columns.name: ASSET_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Asset status code. Possible values are New, Active and Terminated derived from the lookup FLA_ASSET_STATUS.

columns.name: UNIT_OF_MEASURE
columns.description: Attribute indicating Unit of measure used for the asset from inventory.

columns.name: UNITS_CONSUMED
columns.description: Number of units of the asset being taken on lease

columns.name: INTERNAL_LOCATION_CODE
columns.description: Internal Location Code of the asset.

columns.name: SYSTEM_ORIGIN_REFERENCE_1
columns.description: system reference column to maintain the key of source system from which lease is being imported

columns.name: SYSTEM_ORIGIN_REFERENCE_2
columns.description: system reference column to maintain the key of source system from which lease is being imported

columns.name: AMEND_ACTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Amend action type which identifies which action is being performed. Values could be INSERT and UPDATE.

columns.name: IMPAIRMENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type of impairment. Values can be PERCENT or AMOUNT.

columns.name: ASSET_IMPAIRMENT_PERCENT
columns.description: Percentage of asset right of use subject to impairment.

columns.name: IMPAIRMENT_PERCENT
columns.description: This is the percentage by which the asset right of use needs to be changed.

columns.name: PROPERTY_NUMBER
columns.description: Attribute indicating the property number of the property.

columns.name: HIERARCHICAL_PROPERTY_CODE
columns.description: Property code generated by the system which captures the complete hierarchical code of the property.

columns.name: PROPERTY_ID
columns.description: Attribute indicating the property identifier of the property.

columns.name: SHIP_TO_SITE_USE_ID
columns.description: Ship to customer site use identifier.

columns.name: SHIP_CUSTOMER_SITE_NUMBER
columns.description: Ship-to customer account address site number. Site number represents a location in the system.

columns.name: HEADLEASE_ASSET_NUMBER
columns.description: Asset number of the headlease which is associated to the sublease asset.

columns.name: HEADLEASE_LEASE_DETAIL_ID
columns.description: Lease details identifier of the headlease.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
